scale.code_display: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-mono font-bold tracking-widest text-primary

rules: Headlines MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Use IBM Plex Mono for all personal codes and keybox access codes.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and have wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-First Utility. Users will be holding phones in an emergency/maintenance scenario. Tap targets must be huge. Space must clearly separate steps.

patterns.user_view: Single-column vertical flow. Massive typography for the keybox code. Generous spacing (gap-8 or gap-12) between instruction steps.
patterns.admin_view: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) and 1px borders.
patterns.steps: Use large structural numbers (e.g., '01', '02') anchored to the left, with content beside or directly below it.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary_foreground rounded-none px-6 py-4 font-bold text-lg hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-text_primary text-text_primary rounded-none px-6 py-4 font-bold hover:bg-surface transition-colors

cards.rule: Go cardless where possible. If cards are needed, use flat solid surfaces with sharp 1px borders.

inputs.style: border-b-2 border-border bg-transparent px-0 py-3 rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors
inputs.rule: Use brutalist/minimalist input fields. High contrast focus states.

icons.style: Use 'bold' or 'fill' weights for high legibility.

motion.philosophy: Minimalist. No distracting animations during a stressful task.
rules: Use micro-interactions for feedback (button hover, click).
Ensure accordion or tab expansions for instructions use a fast, linear transition (150ms).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black/dark grey text against white background (APCA standard).
accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements, especially on the mobile instruction flow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

hero_context.description: Industrial basement. Use as a subtle background or header image for context (with a heavy white overlay for contrast).

step_keybox.description: Hand operating a combination lockbox. Use in the step detailing how to retrieve the physical key.

step_valves.description: Industrial valve. Use in the step explaining how to switch the water flow/valves.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a utility app for a high-stress scenario (water pump failure). Prioritize absolute clarity and mobile responsiveness.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Chivo' for headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text, and 'IBM Plex Mono' for codes.
Implement the User view as a mobile-first, single-column flow. The shared keybox code must be massive and prominent.
Implement the Step-by-Step instructions with large, high-contrast structural numbers (e.g., '01', '02').
Include a prominent 'Download PDF' button (use Phosphor Icons) in the instructions section.
Implement the Admin Dashboard using a dense 'Control Room' grid layout for managing user access codes and updating instructions.
Use Shadcn UI but heavily customize the appearance to remove Vercel-like aesthetics (use rounded-none, sharp borders, high contrast).
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
